_comment: Decision constants for experiment ab1 (plan sections 2-3, owner decisions D2-D4, D6). Read by harness.py analyze; no threshold literal lives in code. Cost is judged only after runs complete (D6): no run is ever stopped or skipped on token cost.
_comment_A_BASE: baseline mean LOOP output tokens (loop only; deduplicated by message id). R_LOOP = LOOP_T / A_BASE decides cost.
_comment_B_BASE: baseline loop + one audit; R_B = TOK_T / B_BASE is reported only, never decides.
_comment_B_DEFAULT: single-audit baseline values of section 2; recomputed over 12 audits when baseline-audit2 exists (else every comparison is PROVISIONAL).
_comment_MIN_COMPLETED: fewer completed Sonnet runs than this gives INCONCLUSIVE (5 of 6, 8 of 9).

rules._comment_DROP2_RLOOP_LIMIT: D6 conversion: R_LOOP_limit = (L*169468 - 69044)/100424 with original L = 2.0 on R_B (loop + audit) -> 2.6875, rounded 2.69. Replaces the plan's R_LOOP > 2.0. Post-hoc verdict clause only, never a mid-run stop.
rules._comment_DROP4_PASS_MIN: DROP-4 fires when loop PASS count < this (5/6 at n=6, 8/9 at n=9).
rules._comment_ADOPT_AUDFAIL_FACTOR: audit FAIL count <= floor(factor * B_AUDFAIL * n_audits): 5/12 at n=6, 7/18 at n=9.

haiku._comment_harness_fail_margin: ADOPT needs Haiku harness-failure rate <= Haiku baseline rate + this (one run in four), and 1 - HR > 0.
